title: UI风格#58 - Isometric Minimal (等距极简)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Isometric Minimal style When color palette Then features muted pastels, isometric shadows, clean tones
Given Isometric Minimal style When typography Then uses geometric fonts: Nunito Sans, Poppins, or Montserrat

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Isometric Minimal style When layout Then isometric grid, 3D blocks, depth layers
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: perspective iso-grid background, floating iso-block decorations, rounded corners (12px), gradient border on main chat, depth shadows

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Isometric Minimal style When UI elements Then isometric shapes, shadow depth, floating blocks
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: rotateX/Z transforms on blocks, multi-layer shadows, hover lift (translateY -5px), rounded pill buttons, colored left borders on cards

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Isometric Minimal UI When functional Then includes cube chat, block agents, isometric stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Isometric Minimal UI When copy Then uses geometric language: 'Cube', 'Block', 'Grid', 'Layer'
